intent: Follow evening light from the meadow into woodland dusk, through lantern gardens, and out beneath a deep-blue sky. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The late-afternoon meadow
sections.lesson: Hop through the last warm sunlight. Follow the weight as it swings away.
